name: code-agent-memory-mirror
description: Mirror a git store you own (instructions, skills, agent memory, project settings) into Claude Code and Codex, locally and in cloud sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Same instructions, skills and memory in every agent session
interface.longDescription: Keep user instructions, personal skills, agent memory and per-project environment settings in a private git store you own, and mirror it into Claude Code and Codex on every machine and in vendor cloud sessions. The agent-mirror program links the store into each agent's home folder, syncs it with git, moves bulk files through a box, and renders cloud environment settings; the skill guides curating the store.
defaultPrompt: Set up agent-mirror on this machine with my store
Review and tidy the memory for this project
Render the cloud environment settings for this project
